description: Recommend one exact model and effort, plus a budget choice, on Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini or Grok from a live guide. Guidance updates on use.

interface.shortDescription: Choose models with less waste, on any platform
interface.longDescription: For people who use more than one AI platform. Get a short recommendation of one model and effort, plus a budget choice, for your task across the AI platforms you use, based on the live Model Value Map. Ask for detail to see the tradeoff and the Revision. Optional setup adds the guidance to each platform's own instructions and one monthly refresh task. Savings depend on the task and are not guaranteed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Recommend a model and effort for my task on this platform using current guidance.
